automations.title: Maintenance Request Triage & Vendor Dispatch System
automations.summary: A tenant-submitted maintenance request is automatically categorized by urgency and repair type, then routed to the appropriate vendor with the…
steps: A tenant-submitted maintenance request is automatically categorized by urgency and repair type, then routed to the appropriate vendor with the tenant's photos and description attached, instead of the maintenance coordinator manually reading every ticket and deciding who to call.

automations.manualProcess: Without a system in place, a maintenance coordinator has to manually chase down updates, send reminders one by one, and hope nothing falls through the cracks.

automations.title: Rent Payment Reminder & Late Fee Notice System

Every notice is logged with a timestamp, giving a clean record if the matter ever needs to escalate further, and on-time payment rates climb noticeably once tenants know a reminder, not silence, is what follows a missed due date.
automations.manualProcess: The manual approach means an accounts receivable coordinator handles each case reactively, after someone has already noticed something went wrong.

steps: Once a move-out date is confirmed, the automation automatically schedules the cleaning and turn vendor for that unit well ahead of time, keeping the turnaround timeline on track instead of the move coordinator scrambling to line up a vendor only after the unit is already sitting empty and losing rent.

The vendor receives the confirmed date automatically with the unit's specific turn requirements attached, and units consistently turn faster and get back on the market sooner once vendor scheduling happens the moment a move-out is confirmed rather than days afterward.

automations.title: Satisfaction Trend Dashboard Alert
automations.summary: The automation tracks satisfaction survey results over time at the property level and automatically alerts the resident services manager the moment…
steps: The automation tracks satisfaction survey results over time at the property level and automatically alerts the resident services manager the moment scores start trending downward, catching a property-wide problem, a maintenance backlog, a difficult new policy, while there's still time to address it instead of only discovering it during the next lease renewal season when residents are already choosing not to stay.
A single bad survey response is noise, but a sustained downward trend is signal, and this automation is what actually separates the two instead of leaving management to guess which is which.
automations.manualProcess: Left unautomated, a resident services manager spends hours on the parts of this job that don't require judgment: copying data, sending reminders, and tracking status by hand. It rarely feels urgent in the moment, but it adds up fast.

automations.summary: Unit owners automatically receive a reminder ahead of HOA or condo assessment due dates, tracked and sent separately from any regular monthly rent…
steps: Unit owners automatically receive a reminder ahead of HOA or condo assessment due dates, tracked and sent separately from any regular monthly rent reminder so the two obligations never get confused by an owner managing multiple payment types.

The association manager no longer has to manually cross-reference a separate assessment schedule against each owner's file, and late assessment payments, which can affect an entire association's budget and reserve funding, drop meaningfully once every owner gets a clear, timely reminder instead of relying on memory alone.
automations.manualProcess: Without this system, an association manager manually pieces together information from different places, then has to relay it to everyone who needs it. Over a month, those small manual steps add up to a significant amount of lost time.

steps: When a unit is marked as upcoming-vacant, the automation automatically requests that updated photos or a video walkthrough be scheduled before the unit needs to go live on listing sites, instead of the marketing coordinator discovering on posting day that the only photos on file are years old and no longer represent the unit's actual condition.

The request is timed to land with enough lead time for photography to actually happen before the vacancy date, meaning the listing goes live with accurate, current media from day one rather than outdated photos that quietly cost the property qualified inquiries.
automations.manualProcess: Without a system in place, a marketing coordinator has to manually chase down updates, send reminders one by one, and hope nothing falls through the cracks. None of it is difficult, it's just slow, repetitive, and easy to fall behind on.

automations.summary: For companies with maintenance staff serving multiple properties, the automation balances and routes work orders based on each technician's current…
steps: For companies with maintenance staff serving multiple properties, the automation balances and routes work orders based on each technician's current location and workload, instead of the maintenance coordinator dispatching by gut feel and accidentally sending the same tech across town twice in one afternoon while another sits idle nearby.

Jobs get assigned to whichever available technician can actually reach the unit fastest, and average response time across the whole portfolio improves noticeably once dispatch decisions are based on real-time location and workload data instead of a fixed rotation that ignores where everyone actually is.
